summary.text: Zachary Nutting is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 6, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Sean Graves. He previously served in the House representing Cheshire 11 from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Zachary Nutting lives in Winchester, New Hampshire, and his career experience includes working as an office manager for a Massachusetts-based vending company, as a gun shop owner and as a food truck owner, according to Ballotpedia.
Nutting won the 2022 Republican primary for Cheshire 11, defeating Max Santonastaso, and then won the general election over Natalie Quevedo; he took office on December 7, 2022.
He served on the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee in 2023-2024 and resigned from office on September 11, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Cheshire 6 on September 8, 2026, and faces incumbent Democrats Paul Berch and Cathryn A. Harvey in the general election.
